name: TownReporter Desk
reason: The wordmark in the desk header, and the one clickable on the desk that is deliberately NOT underlined (UI1b-3). It is a Link to the desk home, so the guard counts it as a link -- 18 times, once per route -- but the design system says the product name is the brand mark, not a text link: README section 9, "There is no logo mark. The wordmark 'TownReporter' set in Bricolage 800 is the brand", and section 6 keeps the underlined text link for a link inside a sentence, a list title, a heading or a table cell. Underlining the product name in the header would make the brand read as prose. Its bar stays a 44px target, so the exemption covers the underline only; the edge and target rules still apply to it.
